def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Parse prices written as text (e.g. "$300.00")
    df["Price"] = (df["Price"].astype(str)
                     .str.replace(r"[$,]", "", regex=True)
                     .str.strip())
    df["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Price"], errors="coerce")
    df["Quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce")
    # Parse dates, drop rows with unparseable dates
    df["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Date"], errors="coerce")
    df = df[df["Date"].notna()].copy()
    # Drop invalid rows: non-positive quantity or negative price/revenue
    df = df[(df["Quantity"] > 0) & (df["Price"] >= 0)].copy()
    # Recompute revenue to fix cross-column inconsistencies
    df["Revenue"] = df["Quantity"] * df["Price"]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df["Month"] = df["Date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
    total = df.groupby("Month")["Revenue"].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in total.items()}
